bard.name: Blade Ward
bard.description: While you concentrate, every attack roll made against you is reduced by 1d4, blunting incoming blows before they land.

bard.name: Dancing Lights
bard.description: Up to four drifting lights — torches, lanterns, or a vaguely humanoid shape — float where you direct them, shedding dim light. You can move and recombine them as a bonus action while you concentrate.

bard.name: Friends
bard.description: You magically influence one creature you can see, which makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for the duration. When the spell ends, the target knows it was charmed.

bard.name: Light
bard.description: An object you touch glows like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light beyond it. A hostile creature wearing or holding the object can resist with a Dexterity save.

bard.name: Mage Hand
bard.description: A spectral floating hand appears and obeys your gestures for a minute: it can manipulate objects, open unlocked containers, retrieve items, and pour potions, but it cannot attack or carry more than 10 pounds.

bard.name: Mending
bard.description: Your touch knits a single break or tear in an object back together — a snapped chain link, a torn cloak, a cracked key — so long as the damage is no more than a foot in any dimension.

bard.name: Message
bard.description: You point at a creature and whisper a message only it can hear; it can whisper a reply that only you hear. The whisper can pass around corners and through thin barriers, but not through stone, metal, or lead of any real thickness.

bard.name: Minor Illusion
bard.description: You craft a false sound or a still image no larger than a 5-foot cube — a voice, a crash, a chest, a set of footprints. Creatures can see through it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check, and physical interaction reveals it.

bard.name: Prestidigitation
bard.description: The classic bag of minor wonders: light or snuff a candle, clean or soil an object, chill or flavor food, conjure a harmless sensory effect or a tiny trinket. Up to three such effects can run at once.

bard.name: Thunderclap
bard.description: You loose a crack of thunder audible 100 feet away. Every other creature within 5 feet of you makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage, scaling at higher levels.

bard.name: True Strike
bard.description: As part of casting, you make one attack with a weapon, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls. The damage can be radiant instead of the weapon's normal type, and extra radiant damage is added at higher levels, up to +3d6 at 17th.

bard.name: Vicious Mockery
bard.description: A string of magically laced insults: the target makes a Wisdom save or takes psychic damage (1d6) and has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

cleric.name: Guidance
cleric.description: You touch a willing creature and choose one skill. For the duration (up to 1 minute, concentration), whenever the creature makes an ability check with that skill, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

cleric.name: Light
cleric.description: An object you touch glows like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light beyond it. A hostile creature wearing or holding the object can resist with a Dexterity save.

cleric.name: Mending
cleric.description: Your touch knits a single break or tear in an object back together — a snapped chain link, a torn cloak, a cracked key — so long as the damage is no more than a foot in any dimension.

cleric.name: Resistance
cleric.description: You touch one willing creature and choose a damage type: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, radiant, slashing, or thunder. While you concentrate (up to 1 minute), when the creature takes damage of that type, it reduces the damage by 1d4. The creature can benefit from this only once per turn.

cleric.name: Sacred Flame
cleric.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see, which makes a Dexterity save — gaining no benefit from cover — or takes 1d8 radiant damage. The damage increases at higher levels.

cleric.name: Spare the Dying
cleric.description: You stabilize a dying creature at range — 15 feet, growing to 30, 60, and finally 120 feet as you reach higher levels — so it no longer needs death saving throws.

cleric.name: Thaumaturgy
cleric.description: Minor divine wonders announce your power: your voice booms, the ground trembles, flames flicker, doors fly open or slam shut, or your eyes change appearance. Up to three effects can run at once.

cleric.name: Toll the Dead
cleric.description: A dolorous bell tolls for one creature, which makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 necrotic damage — or 1d12 if it is already missing hit points. The damage scales at higher levels.

cleric.name: Word of Radiance
cleric.description: Burning radiance flashes out from you in every direction. Each creature of your choice within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage, scaling at higher levels.

druid.name: Druidcraft
druid.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you predict the weather for the next day, make a flower bloom or a seed pod open, create a harmless nature effect, or light or snuff a small flame.

druid.name: Guidance
druid.description: You touch a willing creature and choose one skill. For the duration (up to 1 minute, concentration), whenever the creature makes an ability check with that skill, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

druid.name: Mending

druid.name: Poison Spray
druid.description: With a 30-foot range, you project a puff of noxious gas with a ranged spell attack. On a hit the target takes 1d12 poison damage, scaling at higher levels.

druid.name: Produce Flame
druid.description: A flame blooms in your hand, shedding light like a torch. You conjure it with a bonus action and can hurl it with an action as a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 fire damage; the damage grows at higher levels.

druid.name: Resistance
druid.description: You touch one willing creature and choose a damage type: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, radiant, slashing, or thunder. While you concentrate (up to 1 minute), when the creature takes damage of that type, it reduces the damage by 1d4. The creature can benefit from this only once per turn.

druid.name: Shillelagh
druid.description: The club or quarterstaff in your hand is imbued with nature's power: you can use your spellcasting ability for its attacks, and its damage becomes force damage with a die that grows as you level.

druid.name: Thorn Whip
druid.description: A whip of thorny vines lashes out in a melee spell attack despite its 30-foot reach, dealing 1d6 piercing damage on a hit and dragging the target up to 10 feet toward you if it is no more than one size larger.

sorcerer.name: Acid Splash

sorcerer.name: Blade Ward
